flagged.title: The Cavalier Parliament and the Religious Settlement
flagged.reason: The video presents John Bunyan as the human face of imprisoned Quakers, which is factually incorrect and would lose students marks on GCSE questions assessing the distinct Nonconformist denominations.

mark_affecting.quote: Because they were so visibly defiant, Quakers were jailed in their absolute thousands. To put a human face on this, think about the famous writer John Bunyan.

flagged.title: The Catholic Question: Popish Plot and Rye House Plot
flagged.reason: The video states both in audio and on-screen text that the Second Test Act of 1678 forced James to step down from the House of Lords, whereas the Act explicitly contained a proviso exempting him.

mark_affecting.quote: forcing James to leave the House of Lords... He was officially forced to step down from the House of Lords.
